TANG SHAO YI (唐紹儀 )
Description: Native of Canton, 53 years old, 5 feet 10 inches,
clean shaven, front of head bald, wears spectacles,
usually wears Chinese clothes.
Address on 4/4/17: 128 and 140 Range Road.
Opium supressed in China as a result of a suggestion made by him
about 1916.
Was President of the Board of Communications when the revolution
broke out in 1911.
Acted as Peace Delegate on behalf of the Manchu Imperial Party,
and assisted Yuan Shih Kai to become first president of China
united. Had trouble with Yuan Shih Kai about 8 months later,
and came to Shanghai. Advised Yuan Shih Kai to resign in 1913.
Appointed Minister of Foreign Affairs in September 1916.
See File No. 570.
Tang Shao Yi's movements re Sino-German crisis See No. 861, 967, 834.
pages.zh:
唐绍仪 (TANG SHAO YI)
描述：广东人，53岁，身高5英尺10英寸，面部无须，前额秃顶，戴眼镜，通常身着中式服装。
1917年4月4日住址：兰路（Range Road）128号和140号。
中国禁绝鸦片系因其于1916年左右提出建议所致。
1911年革命爆发时，任邮传部尚书。
曾代表满清皇室担任议和代表，并协助袁世凯成为中华民国首任大总统。约8个月后与袁世凯发生龃龉，遂来上海。1913年劝袁世凯辞职。
1916年9月被任命为外交总长。
参见档案第570号。
关于唐绍仪在中德危机期间的动向，参见第861、967、834号档案。

Form 2    34
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
Shanghai Municipal Police.    No. 570
Date 28/7/17
CENTRAL POLICE    Station.
27th July,    1917.
REPORT ON Watch on Tang Shao Yi's House.
Made by D. S. Givens.    Forwarded by Chief Detective Inspector.
Sir,
I beg to report that two men were employed watching
Tang Shao Yi's home from 22nd to 26th instant. During that
period Mr. Tang was not seen to enter or leave his house, and
no suspicious persons visited the house.
Enquiries confirm the reports that Tang has gone to
Canton.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D.S.Givens
Detective Sergeant.
Chief Detective Inspector.
（批：ASH / 28.7.）

情报登记 (I. O. REG)
上海公共租界工部局警务处。    第 570 号
日期 1917年7月28日
中央巡捕房。
1917年7月27日。
关于监视唐绍仪住宅的报告。
由 D. S. Givens 撰写。    经首席侦探督察转发。
先生，
谨此报告，本月22日至26日期间，已雇用两人监视唐绍仪寓所。在此期间，未见唐先生进出其寓所，亦无可疑人员造访该寓所。
经查证，证实了唐已前往广州的报告。
此致，
您顺从的仆人，
D.S.Givens
侦探警长。
首席侦探督察。
（批注：ASH / 7月28日。）

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

I. O. K-3
No. 540
Date 14 - 9 - 18
September 14th 1918.

Sir, members/lies neutral in part
The trial of the three Manchus now in custody at the Arsenal commenced yesterday. It is reported that one of them under examination said that the plans of the party included the seizure of the Shanghai Nanking Railway with the assistance of the Woosung troops. The Railway would be used to transport southwards General Chang Hsun and his troops whose assistance and co-operation is relied upon.
The rebels are becoming more and more dissatisfied with the working of the repatriation scheme and allege that the money has been divided among people who are not rebels at all with the result that the genuine applicants get nothing. Some of the more hot-headed of them has gone so far as to advocate the assassination of Han Hwe 韩恢 who has in consequence removed to 12 Zung Yuen Li Avenue Joffre where he refuses to receive visitors particularly those wearing foreign clothes.
++ Tang Shao Yi is leaving by special train for Peking about noon to-day.
The painters strike is still on. The City Guild proposes to circularize the workmen shortly explaining the whole situation to them advising them to return to work and informing them that their refusal to compromise will result in a lock out being declared by all the master painters.

Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

14/9
（批：AM） Captain Superintendent of Police.

（手写日期） 6 p 14

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

I. O. K-3
第 540 号
日期 1918年9月14日。

先生，部分成员/谎言保持中立
目前羁押在兵工厂的三名满人的审判于昨日开始。据报，其中一人在受审时称，该党派的计划包括在吴淞部队的协助下夺取沪宁铁路。该铁路将用于向南运送张勋将军及其部队，各方指望得到他们的协助与合作。
反叛者对遣返方案的运作日益不满，并声称资金已被分给那些根本不是反叛者的人，导致真正的申请者一无所获。其中一些较为冲动的人甚至主张刺杀韩恢 (Han Hwe)，韩恢因此搬至霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）宗元里12号，并拒绝会见访客，尤其是身穿西式服装者。
++ 唐绍仪将于今日中午左右乘专列前往北京。
油漆工罢工仍在继续。市公会拟不久后向工人散发通告，向他们解释整个局势，建议他们复工，并告知他们，若拒绝妥协，所有油漆行东将宣布停工。

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
首席侦探督察。

9月14日
（批注：AM） 警务处总监。

（手写日期） 下午6点 14日
